query: Explain why some Qatar Airways Business-Class flights receive a non-recommended (Recommended = no) result.

per_column.name: Review_Length
per_column.rationale: Bare text length of the review. It is a property of the review text, not a cause of the flight being non-recommended; at most a proxy/collider driven by the reviewer's experience. Generic, mechanical feature with no causal standing.

per_column.name: Rating_Variance
per_column.rationale: Variance across the sub-ratings is a downstream summary of the same ratings that drive recommendation. It sits on/after the causal path (function of outcomes-correlated ratings), not a common cause of any treatment and the outcome.

per_column.name: Complaint_Count
per_column.rationale: Number of complaints extracted from the review reflects the negative experience that then leads to a non-recommendation. It lies on the causal path between the underlying service failures and the outcome, so it is a mediator, not a confounder.

per_column.name: Low_Rating_Count
per_column.rationale: Count of low sub-ratings is essentially the mechanism producing non-recommendation; a near-deterministic descendant of the ratings that drive the outcome, not a common cause.

per_column.name: Has_Major_Complaint
per_column.rationale: Presence of a major complaint is part of the causal path to non-recommendation, expressing the same dissatisfaction rather than an upstream common cause of a distinct treatment.

per_column.name: Overall_Low
per_column.rationale: Binarised low Overall Rating is a near-proxy of the recommendation decision itself; overall rating and recommendation are co-determined by the experience. It is a descendant/mediator, not a confounder.

per_column.name: Service_Comfort_Gap
per_column.rationale: Gap between service and comfort sub-ratings is a derived experience measure on the path to (non-)recommendation, not a common cause of a treatment and the outcome.

judge.rationale: No column is a candidate CAUSE (treatment) whose effect on non-recommendation is being attributed while being distinct from the outcome mechanism. Every substantive added column (Complaint_Count, Low_Rating_Count, Has_Major_Complaint, Overall_Low, Service_Comfort_Gap, Rating_Variance) is a downstream descendant/mediator/collider of the same dissatisfaction that determines recommendation, and Review_Length is a generic text feature. Crucially, the system supplied NO confounder -- no variable that plausibly causes both a treatment and the outcome (e.g., route difficulty, aircraft type, prior expectation, traveller sub-segment) is surfaced. Because there is neither a clean treatment nor any adjusted-for confounder, the causal-attribution claim is not realised.
